title: SIGNAL Newsroom
summary: A calm, responsive editorial front page that helps readers scan consequential technology and climate reporting without losing hierarchy or agency.

overview.goal: Make a dense independent newsroom immediately understandable across narrow and wide screens.
overview.scope: A dependency-free editorial homepage and its bounded interaction trace.

behavior.user_goal: Find the most relevant story, understand its relative importance, and continue reading without coercive interaction.
agency: no dark patterns or data collection

rationale: editorial weight is expressed with type and space
visible labels preserve meaning without icon dependence
local fonts and restrained motion keep the reading surface reliable

architecture.data_flow: semantic document to responsive projection to bounded local interaction evidence

debug_path: inspect the browser console and local resource requests
inspect the bounded SIGNAL debug trace
run the publish-safety verifier and focused tests
scale_path: extract repeated editorial primitives only after a second content product proves the boundary
move story data behind a validated content contract
add routing and content delivery without changing the semantic reading hierarchy
